ideas.title: Crash Dummies for Cash 🚗
ideas.hook: Strap a crash-test dummy to the hood, floor it down a test track and slam into the wall. The further the dummy flies, the more the lab pays.
core_loop: Pick a car and a dummy
Speed down the test track and hit the barrier
Earn cash for distance, flips and broken parts
Buy faster cars, launch ramps and tougher dummies
Unlock new tracks (cliff, ice lake, moon base)
ideas.twist: Bones and bolts on the dummy break one by one, and each broken part is a bonus payout, so players aim crashes instead of just going fast.
retention: Daily crash challenge (hit a target zone)
Collect every car in the garage
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is the top rising mechanic at 2.79 momentum (36 new games), and Physics Sim is the fastest subgenre at 2.16 with Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (17,562 CCU) and Bloody Ragdoll Physics 🩸 (18,959 CCU). Hit + Race / drive is a live pair (6 new games, 50,635 CCU), and realistic art is rising at 1.88.
ideas.differentiator: Ragdoll games launch the player by hand; here the car is the launcher, so vehicle upgrades and ragdoll physics feed one loop.

ideas.title: Draw Arks for the Flood 🌊
ideas.hook: A flood wave is coming in 60 seconds. Draw your boat with your finger, it turns into a real floating ship, and the wave decides if your design was any good.
core_loop: Get a round prompt (carry 3 animals, hold 4 players)
Draw a hull, sails and walls in 60 seconds
Watch your drawing turn into a physics boat
Ride out the flood wave and storms
Earn ink and colours for surviving longer
ideas.twist: Each round adds one twist to the flood (whirlpool, lightning, giant shark), so a design that won last round can sink this one.
retention: Gallery of best boats voted by players
ideas.why_now: Paint / create × Disaster / weather is the biggest gap in the data (score 4.3). Paint / create sits at 1.70 momentum (27 new games) and Disaster / weather at 1.93 with [🌊] Steal Eggs From Tsunami! (7,724 CCU) and [🏁] Steal A Pet And Ride It! (13,894 CCU). New draw games in the vision pass score drawings with a % on the thumbnail.
ideas.differentiator: Draw games today judge pictures; here the drawing has to physically float, so the score comes from the flood, not a vote.

ideas.title: Stamp Bills for Cash 💵
ideas.hook: You're the bank teller. Customers slide cash across the counter and you have seconds to stamp REAL or FAKE. Get it right and your vault grows.
core_loop: A customer hands over bills
Check the watermark, serial and colour
Stamp REAL or FAKE before the timer runs out
Earn a cut of every correct deposit
Upgrade tools (UV lamp, magnifier) and move to bigger banks
ideas.twist: Some customers are other players running a counterfeiter shift, designing fakes to trick the teller for bonus cash.
ideas.why_now: Quiz / guess × Money / rich is the second-biggest gap (score 4.04). Money / rich is at 1.62 momentum (56 new games) with [🐟] Net a Fish! (20,842 CCU) and [⚡] Steal a Superpower! (12,432 CCU); Quiz / guess is rising at 1.14 with Thai Quiz Duels [UPDATES] (3,122 CCU), and interior maps are at 1.83.
ideas.differentiator: Quiz games ask trivia; here every question is a bill in your hand, and players can be the ones making the fakes.

ideas.title: +1 Robot Per Zap 🤖
ideas.hook: Every scrap bot you zap joins your side. One zap, one more robot following you. Grow from a lone zapper into a marching metal army.
core_loop: Zap wild scrap bots
Each zap adds +1 robot to your army
March your army into bigger zones with tougher bots
Spend bolts on zap range and army speed
Rebirth to keep a robot multiplier
ideas.twist: Your army is the health bar: in boss fights robots fall off one by one, so a bigger army means you last longer.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action × Robots / mechs is a top gap (score 3.46, thin). The +1 title formula is at 1.95 momentum (32 new games) with [⚔️UPD] +1 Venom Evolution (16,934 CCU) and +1 Spider Arm🕷️ (7,930 CCU). Robots / mechs is rising at 1.60 with Sweep The Moon 🌕 (11,626 CCU), and Fight + +1 is a live pair (8 new games, 27,434 CCU).
ideas.differentiator: +1 games grow one stat on one avatar; here the stat is a visible crowd of robots you can see growing behind you.

ideas.title: Bag Sand for Cash 🌊
ideas.hook: A flood alert hits town. Shovel sand, fill bags and sell them to panicking neighbours before the water arrives. When it's gone, prices crash and you prep for the next storm.
core_loop: Shovel sand and fill bags at your yard
Sell stacks to houses on your street
Watch prices spike as the storm siren gets closer
Upgrade shovels, trucks and bag fillers
Expand to new disaster towns (tornado, volcano, snowstorm)
ideas.twist: Houses you supplied survive the flood and pay you a thank-you bonus; houses you skipped wash away, so you choose who to save.
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop × Disaster / weather is a top gap (score 3.24). Disaster / weather is at 1.93 momentum with [🌊] Steal Eggs From Tsunami! (7,724 CCU), and Sell / run a shop is at 1.28 (36 new games) with Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 (12,365 CCU) and Sell a Million Sushi (6,408 CCU).
ideas.differentiator: Shop games sell food at steady prices; here demand rises with a storm timer, so timing your sales is the skill.

ideas.title: Sprint for Moon Rocks 🌕
ideas.hook: Sneak into the moon base, grab a glowing moon rock and run it back to your rocket in low gravity while guard robots chase you down.
core_loop: Land next to a moon base
Grab a moon rock (bigger rocks slow you down)
Bounce across craters back to your rocket
Sell rocks to unlock faster suits and jetpacks
Raid harder bases on Mars and beyond
ideas.twist: Low gravity means every jump is a long float; guard robots can't jump, so good players bounce over them instead of running around.
retention: Limited meteor shower events with rare rocks
ideas.why_now: Space is the second-fastest theme at 1.85 with Sweep The Moon 🌕 (11,626 CCU), and Escape + Steal / raid is a live pair (6 new games, 24,639 CCU) led by [🏁] Steal A Pet And Ride It! (13,894 CCU). Escape / run is at 1.46 (40 new games) and linear course maps lead map styles at 2.07.
inspired_by: [🏁] Steal A Pet And Ride It!
ideas.differentiator: Steal-and-run games happen on flat ground; low gravity turns every escape into a jump puzzle.

ideas.title: Be a Giant Farmer 🌾
ideas.hook: One player is a giant farmer whose crops tower over a tiny village. Everyone else is a tiny villager living between the stalks, helping or sneaking off with the harvest.
core_loop: Giant plants and waters huge crops
Tiny villagers harvest pieces and carry them to the barn
Villagers trade crops in the tiny town for houses and upgrades
Giant earns from the full harvest and expands the farm
Switch roles each round
ideas.twist: Villagers can keep a share of what they carry, but if the giant catches them stealing they get dropped in the pond, so every round is part farm, part heist.
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm + Roleplay / life sim is a live pair (5 new games, 24,207 CCU), with Grow / farm at 1.43 (44 new games, [2x WEEKEND] Farm Evolution at 11,391 CCU). Giant / huge is rising at 1.59 with Raise The Biggest Family (9,011 CCU), and the "Be a ___" formula is at 1.38 with ⚽ Be a Soccer Legend (8,049 CCU).
ideas.differentiator: Farm games are solo plots; here one giant and a crowd of tiny players share a single farm with clashing goals.

ideas.title: Fire Friends for Medals 🪖
ideas.hook: Load your friend into a mortar, aim and fire them across a war-zone range to land on target flags. Bullseyes earn medals.
core_loop: Climb into the mortar or aim it
Fire across the range at target flags
Score medals for distance and accuracy
Unlock bigger cannons and ragdoll gear
Swap roles and fire back
ideas.twist: Players in mid-air can steer a little with a parachute, so the shooter aims and the flyer corrects together.
ideas.why_now: Hit + Shooter is a live pair (4 new games, 43,274 CCU) and Hit / swing / launch leads mechanics at 2.79. Physics Sim is at 2.16 with Ragdoll Physics 🩸 (17,278 CCU), and Military / war is up 0.48 this week to 1.23 with Voxel Wars (8,100 CCU) and Ragdoll Wars! (5,409 CCU).
ideas.differentiator: Ragdoll war games are free-for-all chaos; this is a two-player aim-and-steer game built for friends.

ideas.title: Guess the Giant Thing 🔍
ideas.hook: You're shrunk to ant size standing on something huge. Look around and guess what it is before the camera zooms out and shows everyone.
core_loop: Spawn tiny on a giant everyday object
Walk around and look for clues
Type your guess before the zoom-out
Fast right answers score the most
Unlock new rooms of giant objects
ideas.twist: Players can climb and explore during the round, so the first to find a clue (a giant label, a button) can race to answer.
ideas.why_now: Quiz / guess × Giant / huge is an open gap (score 3.0). Giant / huge is at 1.59 momentum (20 new games) with Bug Evolution [☀️] (7,322 CCU), Quiz is at 1.36 as a subgenre with Thai Quiz Duels [UPDATES] (3,122 CCU) and [UPD] Find The Country 🌍 (1,122 CCU), and interior maps are rising at 1.83.
ideas.differentiator: Quiz games show a picture; here you stand on the answer and explore it, so it plays like a mini obby.

ideas.title: Build a Meteor Shield ☄️
ideas.hook: Meteors rain down every few minutes. Build a dome shield over your base, power it with generators, and whatever survives the shower keeps paying you.
core_loop: Build generators and money machines on your plot
Power a shield dome over them
Survive the meteor shower
Collect space rocks that land outside the shield
Upgrade the shield and expand the base
ideas.twist: Shield power is shared with your income, so a stronger shield means slower earnings; players choose when to drop it to grab falling space rocks.
ideas.why_now: The "Build a ___" formula is up 0.16 this week to 1.19 with Build a Bridge (5,956 CCU). Space is at 1.85 with Sweep The Moon 🌕 (11,626 CCU), Disaster / weather is at 1.93, and Tycoon / base building has the most new games of any rising mechanic (93, 1.28 momentum).
ideas.differentiator: Tycoons just grow; here every meteor shower can wreck what you built, so defense and income fight for the same power.
